grammar_focus: 一般过去时(主考:表过去某时发生并已结束的动作 · 规则动词词尾加 -ed · 不规则动词过去式单独记 told/sang/felt/woke/crept/slept/wound/found · 否定 did not + 原形 · 疑问 Did + 主语 + 原形 · 过去时间标志 yesterday/ago/last night)+ as soon as 引导时间状语从句 / so 连接结果(辅考)
scene: 傍晚男孩们在田野中央搭起帐篷,篝火做饭、讲故事唱歌;后来下起雨,他们熄火钻进睡袋睡得正香。半夜两人惊醒——帐篷里灌满了水!原来雨下得大,田里形成一条小溪,正好从帐篷底下流过。

grammar_card.title: 说'过去发生的事'(一般过去时)
grammar_card.intro: 本课讲一般过去时——表示过去某个时候发生并已经结束的动作。规则动词词尾加 -ed;很多常用动词是不规则的,要单独记。全用本课句子举例。

rows: 表过去发生并结束:一般过去时
They cooked a meal over an open fire.
They hurried outside. / A stream formed.
否定 / 疑问:did not / Did …
Did they cook a meal? / They did not stay inside.

specialRules.rule: as soon as = '一……就……',引导时间从句:As soon as this was done, they cooked a meal.
so = '所以/因此',连接结果:The boys felt tired, so they put out the fire.

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — What happened to the boys in the night?
options: Their tent was full of water

passage: Late in the afternoon, the boys put up their tent in the middle of a field. As soon as this was done, they cooked a meal over an open fire. They were all hungry and the food smelled good. After a wonderful meal, they told stories and sang songs by the campfire. But some time later it began to rain. The boys felt tired so they put out the fire and crept into their tent. Their sleeping bags were warm and comfortable, so they all slept soundly. In the middle of the night, two boys woke up and began shouting. The tent was full of water! They all leapt out of their sleeping bags and hurried outside. It was raining heavily and they found that a stream had formed in the field. The stream wound its way across the field and then flowed right under their tent!

grammar_points.name: 一般过去时表过去某时发生并已结束的动作

不规则动词过去式(单独记)
一般过去时的否定:did not + 动词原形
一般过去时的一般疑问:Did + 主语 + 动词原形
